full_prompt_en: A square overhead photograph shows a black ink drawing on a nearly square sketchbook page surrounded by drawing pens. The paper occupies most of the frame, with its white margin visible along the lower and side edges against a dark desk. Several black pens lie at the left and right, their straight barrels crossing the more organic lines of the artwork. The drawing centers on a young face looking upward and slightly right. Large eyes, a small nose and a faint smile are built from precise contour lines and fine hatching. The hair breaks into pointed dark strands beneath an oversized mushroom cap that stretches across the upper center. On the right of the face, a smaller round mushroom has spotted skin and a single eye-like circle, giving the surrounding foliage a fanciful character. Dense leaves, curled fronds and small flowers press in from every side and partly cover the neck and shoulders. Some leaf outlines stay pale, while clustered crosshatching and black pools create deep recesses behind them. A narrow pale flying shape near the upper left adds another interruption to the packed botanical field. The drawn face remains the lightest and clearest open area, its smooth white cheeks set against densely marked hair and plants. Overhead light falls softly across the page, making the paper bright and the pens slightly reflective; shadows from the tools stay compact near their edges. The image remains monochrome apart from the warm gray desk, and the ink uses stippling, parallel hatching and varied line weight instead of smooth tonal gradients. The overall composition balances the calm upward gaze against an intricate, almost overflowing thicket of drawn detail, while the visible tools keep the image rooted in a working sketchbook.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形俯视照片显示一张近乎方形的素描本纸页上有黑色钢笔画，周围放着绘图笔。纸页占画面大部分，白色下缘和侧缘露在深色桌面上。几支黑笔放在左右，笔杆直线横过画中更有机的线条。画作中央是一张向上、略向右望的年轻面孔。大眼睛、小鼻子和淡笑由准确轮廓线及细密排线组成。头发在横过上方中央的巨型蘑菇伞下裂成尖锐深色发束。面孔右侧，较小的圆蘑菇有斑点表皮和一圈像眼睛的圆形，使周围枝叶带奇异气息。密集叶片、卷曲蕨叶和小花从四面挤入，部分遮住颈肩。有些叶缘保持浅白，密集交叉排线和黑色团块则在其后造出深凹处。左上附近一只狭长浅色飞形又打断繁密植物区。画中面孔仍是最浅、最清楚的开敞区域，平滑白面颊与密集标记的头发和植物对照。顶光柔和地铺在纸上，让纸面明亮，笔杆微微反光；工具投影紧贴其边。除暖灰桌面外，图像保持单色，墨线用点描、平行排线和变化线重代替平滑色调渐变。整体构图以平静向上的目光平衡复杂到几乎溢出的绘画枝叶，露出的工具则让图像扎根于工作中的素描本。
style_prompt_en: The image has a fine black ink drawing surface captured with a quiet overhead photographic view. Dense contour lines, crosshatching and stippling build dark pockets around broad untouched white areas. Line weight varies from hair-thin detail to firm black accents, keeping the most intricate regions legible. Organic curves and tight clusters press toward an open focal zone, while a few straight external edges provide a stable frame. Soft overhead light makes the pale ground even and gives nearby smooth surfaces small subdued highlights. Tonal depth comes from mark density rather than colored shading, and slight paper grain remains visible within the open spaces. The overall effect is intricate but controlled, with clear negative space preventing dense detail from becoming a uniform gray field.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细密黑墨画表面，以安静的俯视摄影角度呈现。密集轮廓、交叉排线和点描在大片未着墨白区周围堆出暗处。线重从发丝般细节到坚实黑色强调变化，使最繁复区域仍可读。有机曲线和紧密群组向开敞焦点区挤去，少量外部直边提供稳定框架。柔和顶光使浅底均匀，并让附近平滑表面带小而低调的亮点。色调纵深来自笔痕密度而非彩色阴影，开放区域仍见轻微纸颗粒。整体效果繁细却受控，清楚负空间防止密集细节变成一片均匀灰色。
theme_en: A detailed black ink drawing of a young face among dense leaves and fanciful mushrooms on a sketchbook page
theme_zh: 素描本页上年轻面孔被繁密叶片与奇异蘑菇环绕的黑色钢笔画
name: Kerby Rosanes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
